issues.problem: Microsoft's fiscal 2025 net income was about $101.8 billion, not $127.3 billion. The stated figure is also implausible because it is nearly equal to operating income ($128.5B), which can't happen at a normal tax rate of about 18%. I checked this figure even though the text says it was already verified, because it is wrong.

data.summary: Most of the figures match Microsoft's fiscal 2025 results: revenue of $281.7B, up 14.9% from $245.1B; operating income of $128.5B; total assets of $619.0B; and cash and cash equivalents of about $30.2B. Net income is wrong. It was about $101.8B, not $127.3B.
